Perks › Uncommon

Open Book

Uncommon perk · Active ability

Once per hand, reveal one hidden bone of your choice to reveal a random hidden rival bone. Both racks need at least three bones; revealed bones stay public while held.

In-game card text

How it works

Once per hand, choose one of your own hidden bones to reveal to Rival. In return, one of Rival's hidden bones is chosen at random and revealed to you.

  • Both racks need at least three bones, and each needs at least one bone that is still hidden.
  • Revealed bones stay face-up for as long as their owner holds them, so Rival can see the bone you showed.
  • More copies do not give more uses; it stays once per hand.

At a glance

RarityUncommon
TypeActive ability
UsesOne use per hand no matter how many copies you hold.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 300 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Common perks.
